cards.title: Button Bakery Map Mixup Story Scene Chain Card
cards.chainSkill: connect a button-map start scene to a next scene, bridge detail, change marker, return detail, and paper pocket note
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only expanding file scene chain card for a made-up Button Bakery map mixup with button markers, page notes, and paper pocket sorting: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out an expanding file, one blank page, a pencil, and a pretend button map drawn only for this scene chain: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: keep the Button Bakery story made-up by moving one map clue from the start scene to the next scene, then into a paper pocket: ____________________.
cards.startScenePrompt: Start scene: write who finds the pretend button map and what one marker seems to point toward on the page: ____________________.
cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: write what the helper notices after turning the page, such as a shifted button, a new arrow, or a folded corner: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: add one small detail that connects the first map marker to the new page clue: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: mark the exact moment the scene chain changes with a new symbol, color word, or paper fold: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first button marker so the later scene connects to the beginning: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: label one expanding file paper pocket with the button clue that should travel to the next page: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the start scene and return detail blanks for the button-map mixup: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: make another Button Bakery scene chain with one pretend map marker and one paper pocket note: ____________________.

cards.nextScenePrompt: Next scene: write what changes when the cart reaches the next made-up station, such as a new sticker shape or turned slip: ____________________.
cards.bridgeDetailPrompt: Bridge detail: add one concrete detail that links the first sticker slip to the new station clue: ____________________.
cards.changeMarkerPrompt: Change marker: write the word or symbol on the page that shows the scene chain has shifted: ____________________.
cards.returnDetailPrompt: Return detail: bring back the first sticker slip with a clearer meaning in the later scene: ____________________.
cards.filePocketPrompt: File pocket note: choose the expanding file paper pocket that should hold the sticker clue for the next page: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the sticker slip at the start and how it returns later: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Later paper line: start another Sticker Station scene chain with one pretend sort slip and one paper pocket label: ____________________.
